game.desc: King Kong on Xbox 360 is an action game inspired by Peter Jackson's feature film. Retracing the adventures of the giant gorilla, the game offers you first of all first-person shooter phases before embodying the animal and fighting dinosaurs. You will find the key moments of the film as well as the voices and faces of the actors.
